title: [Zero to ASIC] Apparently, You can Vibe-code analog radio circuits now.
text:

Video from Matt Venn showing his experience with AI assisted analog chip design. There is also explanation page (use arrows to navigate between pages) and 3D web based gds viewer.

A radio on a tiny open-source chip

Explore a 433 MHz radio on a Tiny Tapeout chip, from the transistors to the received bits, with simulated waveforms.

zerotoasiccourse.com

Tiny Tapeout GDS Viewer

There is also benchmark specialized in analog circuits, Gemini 4 is leading right now.

Razavi-Bench -- Analog Design Reasoning Benchmark

An expert-curated benchmark that tests whether frontier AI models can reason about analog circuit design.

razavi-bench.tokenzhang.com

What do You think? Did Your opinion changed in past months? I can see more people abandoning extremally positive or negative positions and just accepting that it is just another valid tool.
